entities.label: Place
entities.summary: The largest contiguous land empire in history (1206-1368), founded by Genghis Khan and spanning from Korea to Hungary at its peak. The Mongol Empire — through devastating conquest and administrative innovation — created the Pax Mongolica, enabling unprecedented exchange of goods, ideas, technologies, and diseases across Eurasia.
